summary.text: Morgan Meyer is a Republican state representative from Texas who has represented District 108 since 2015 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He holds a bachelor's degree from Southern Methodist University and a law degree from Washington and Lee Law School.

paragraphs.text: Morgan Meyer earned a B.S. from Southern Methodist University and a J.D. from Washington and Lee Law School.
Meyer assumed office in the Texas House in 2015.
At the start of the 2015 session he served on the Energy Resources and Insurance committees, and in 2017 he served on Public Education and State Affairs.
In 2019 and 2020 he chaired the General Investigating Committee, and in 2021 through 2024 he chaired the Ways & Means Committee.
